narrative_zh: 10 号飓风信号维持 10 小时。山竹在香港以南约 100 公里掠过，推高全港风暴潮逾 2 米：鲗鱼涌最高潮位 3.88 米（海图基准面，增水 2.35 米），大埔滘 4.71 米（增水 3.40 米），均为有仪器记录以来最高。杏花邨、鲤鱼门、将军澳南、沙田、大埔、大澳等地严重水浸。
narrative_en: Hurricane Signal No. 10 lasted 10 hours as Mangkhut passed ~100 km south of Hong Kong. Storm surge exceeded 2 m territory-wide: Quarry Bay peaked at 3.88 m CD (surge 2.35 m) and Tai Po Kau at 4.71 m CD (surge 3.40 m), both instrumental records. Heng Fa Chuen, Lei Yue Mun, TKO South, Sha Tin, Tai Po and Tai O were seriously flooded.

validation.basis: 天文台：海水涌入屋邨及地下停车场；HK01 图辑：地库停车场多辆汽车没顶 → ≥ 1.5 m
validation.en: Heng Fa Chuen basement car parks
validation.src: HKO TC report 2018: sea water entered the estate & underground car parks; HK01 2018-09-16 photo report: cars in the basement car park fully submerged (沒頂) -> depth >= 1.5 m
validation.note_zh: 越浪主导：海堤顶高于静水位，越浪源项（EurOtop）落在堤顶格；报道的 1.2 m 发生在地下停车场——v0.4 起以手工数字化的地下停车场（楼面与深度为估计值）作为下沉汇，验证值取车库内水深 = 流入体积 / 楼面面积
validation.note_en: Wave-overtopping dominated: crest above the still-water level, EurOtop source applied on the crest cell; the reported 1.2 m was in the underground car parks, which the DTM does not contain - the model gives promenade / ground-level depths

validation.basis: 沙田区议会文件 STDC 93/2018：渠务署记旧村停车场水深 1 m 以上、警方记旧村最高水位约 1.5 m，议员称「水深超过 1 米」；均非测量
validation.zh: 沙田曾大屋旧村停车场
validation.en: Tsang Tai Uk old village car park, Sha Tin
validation.note_zh: 取样点是围屋东侧的旧村停车场低洼处（DTM 5.1–5.3 mPD，四周道路 5.8–6.1），不是 6.0 mPD 的围屋本身。沙田区议会 STDC 93/2018：渠务署称曾大屋旧村是低洼地，雨水不能直接排入附近排水系统，先入蓄洪池再由泵房抽走；议员称当日乡公所对出的渠务署水泵已停运；渠务署记停车场水深 1 m 以上、警方记旧村最高水位约 1.5 m。沙田没有验潮站（渠务署以大埔滘 4.54 mPD 为准；沙田最高十分钟平均风速仅 58 km/h，风壅水 < 0.15 m，模型取 +5% 约 4.65 mPD），河水淹不到 5.1 mPD 的停车场：水来自本地降雨 + 泵停运（v0.8 起作为临时措施建模）
validation.note_en: Sample point: the low pocket of the old-village car park east of the walled house (DTM 5.1-5.3 mPD, surrounding roads 5.8-6.1), not the 6.0 mPD walled compound. Sha Tin DC paper STDC 93/2018: DSD states the old village is a low-lying spot whose runoff cannot drain directly into the local system but collects in a storage pond and is pumped out; the councillor reported the DSD pump outside the village office had stopped; DSD logged over 1 m in the car park, the Police about 1.5 m. Sha Tin has no tide gauge (DSD refers to Tai Po Kau 4.54 mPD; peak 10-min wind at Sha Tin only 58 km/h, set-up < 0.15 m, model +5% ~ 4.65 mPD): the river cannot reach the 5.1 mPD car park, the water is local rain with the pump down (modelled as a temporary measure from v0.8)

validation.basis: 天文台：单车径与行人隧道被海水淹浸，无深度
validation.note_zh: 城门河西岸（沙田公园以北）。单车径阶地不在数据里：CEDD LiDAR 在河道走廊无回波、LandsD 填成 5.27 mPD 平面，10 m 格与 1 m 分位数都没有阶地。按沙田区议会文件 ST 2018/094（河堤即单车径约 3–6 mPD、河边长廊 2.6 mPD 以上）取阶地 3.5 mPD：模拟值 = 模型在此处的河道峰值水位 − 3.5，即只检验沙田的潮位推算，不是地表水动力。v0.8 前此点误放在西侧 300 m 外的明渠旁
validation.note_en: West bank north of Sha Tin Park. The cycle-track berm is absent from the data (no LiDAR returns over the river corridor, LandsD fill at a flat 5.27 mPD, neither the 10 m cell nor the 1 m quantiles hold it). Berm taken as 3.5 mPD from Sha Tin DC paper ST 2018/094 (cycle-track embankment about 3-6 mPD, promenade 2.6 mPD or above): sim = peak modelled river level here minus 3.5, i.e. a test of the Sha Tin tide estimate, not of surface hydraulics. Before v0.8 the point sat 300 m west beside a nullah
